book.name: Luk
book.title: LUK Kamambuno Wakai Luk Muno Boglkwa

content: Yesus eremogl Parisi ta keipamara yungugl moglkwa
Sabat enge suwarata Yesus endpi Parisi yagl kande ta keipamara yungugl kaiya mokna nina pre ongo ana yomba tau Yesus ta erambere kanamnedi pre sugl wakai ere kanmeglkwa.
Igle yagl ta ongo kagle pond yakungwa, ye Yesus moglmara ungwa.
Ana Yesus krapogl Parisi wagle ya te lo pirpogl singwa yomba tongwa, “Lo mina yomba kinde sungwa Sabat enge, erewakai eriyo dumo mo dikrume?”
Ba ye ka ta dikre kiendi kaima meglkwa. Ana Yesus yaglmo di-indre erewakai erete ana diendungwa.
Ana Yesus krapogl tongwa, “Ene mina yomba suwarata wan mo buglan kau ta Sabat enge yange maugl atne sinan, ene oglandi kaima gundo i menda endekratno?”
Ana ye ka i ta di ikine endinaglkwa mere manga.
Yomba yene wedi piran atne erambuka
Yesus kangwa yomba kaiya mokna yumbusi neimara i, ye angai gumamugl inamunedi erikwa ipre ana ye ka i di simbogl ditongwa,
“Yagl ambu bogl ingwa kaiya mokna bir neimara ene ta wo dinan, ene emin ana ene bogl gumamugl ikro, sraglpre, yomba kande ta mogl-mitna ende ene engrukwa ye wo dungwa.
Ana yagl ta ene suwo-akiye dungo umbrika yagle i wu ene yegl ditenambuka, ‘Ene botnen yagl ta i to’ dinan. Ana ene angai gogltre endpi bogl mokonomugl amedinatnga.

Ba yomba ta ene wo dimbi ana ene pi angai mokomugl kaima i yo, yegl erimbi ene digaglkwa yagl undre ana ene yegl ditenambuka, ‘Yeinombuglka, ene ende wu angai wakaile inda po dumara ipre.’ Ana yomba prapra ene digaglko wu meglmara gumanomugl ene kangin kande inatnga.
Yeglpre, yomba yene ta kangiye akepledi mitna endinan God ye ake atne endinambuka ana yomba yene ta kangiye ake atne endinan, ye kangiye God akepledi mitna endinambuka.”
Taragl noro ikine endekraglkwa yomba i nono wakai ere tenamga

Ana Yesus eremogl digaglkwa yomba ditongwa, “Ene kaiya mokna ande mume dinan mo mim panan tenatnga enge, ene yeinenga mo angitnma mo bormai suwara mo moni bona mere paitongwa yomba mangigl meglkwa i ene digaglkro. Ene yegl etn, ye ama ene digagl ikine ende ana mongo pundo te ikine endinaglkwa.
Ba ene kaiya mokna bir tenatnga enge, ene kiuglgiunde ya, kaglande singwa ya, onguno katno kinde orkwa ya te ongumutno mim orkwa yomba digatn,
ana God eran ene gun yenatnga, sraglpre ye ene mongo pundo bagl te ikine endekraglkwa. Okuwo yomba du-yene geglkwa andraglkwa enge i God ene topo te ikine endinambuka.”
Kaiya mokna bir tambuno kande neingwa ka di simboglkwa

Yomba meglmara igle yagl ta Yesus bogl akiye bogl mina amedi miurka. Ye ka i pirtre, yegl di Yesus tongwa, “God kingdomo mina suna yomba ta bogl mina amedi kaiya mokna bir ne morambuka ye gun pond yenambuka.”
Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Yomba ta kaiya mokna bir kande ninaglkwa pre akekun ereyei ana yomba merkinde digaglkwa.
Ana kaiya mokna ninaglkwa enge yongo ye okuna wiyo digaglkwa yomba ikra di endimbi unaglkwa pre ye nigl kongunmo yomba diedungwa.

“Ba yomba prapra ye mambuno bogl konguno kanekane pame dingwa. Ana komnaiye yagl ta yegl di kongun yomba tongwa, ‘Na makan kor erme topo erika, ana na pindre makanmo i kanaglka. Na ta ukraglka pamiwo.’
“Ana ta dungwa, ‘Na erme keunde bugla-kau 10 kongun eraglkwa pre topo erika ana nana pindre ye kongun eraglmere ombuno dinaglka. Ene wakai dinga ba na ta ukragliwo.’
“Ta ama yegl dungwa, ‘Na ambu erme inga, yeglpre na ta ukraglka.’

“Ana kongun yomba ende ikine undre ana ye ka i boglo kugl yombamo kande tongwa. Ana yungu nemyagl dem kumbruko ana ye kongunmo yomba ditongwa, ‘Oglandi kaima ende taun suna pindre konbauna kande ya kembra prapra pi ana kiuglgiunde yomba ya mau singwa ya ongumutno mim orkwa ya te katno kinde orkwa ana auro yend suna wo.’
“Kongun yomba dungwa, ‘Yagl kande, ene taragl dinere ere kondiga ba yomba mere yungu kulano yoko yei pangwa.’

“Ana yagl kande di kongunmo yomba tongwa, ‘Ende menda pi makan kande konbauna prapra ya makai dumo ya konbauna pi sing yomara yomba ditemin, ye ende suna wiyondo. Yegl erimbi na yunguna kau sinambuka.
Na ene diteinga, yomba prapra okuna wiyo digaglka yomba ikra ye na kaiya mokna bir ninaglmara ye kuri kaima ta ne pirkraglkwa.’”
Pir dime dindre Yesus disaipelma moraglkwa
Ana yomba merkinde Yesus omara akiye eingo, ana ye kan aketendre ditongwa,
“Yomba suwarata na moglmara unambuka, ba yene mam ya yene embiye ya nangiglma ya yene angiglma ambaglma mo yene kor-moglkwa ipre kinde piran kade eran ye kaima na disaipelna moglkrambuka.
Ana yomba ta yene endimo-prak kake ikre, na mokonamugl unan, ana ye na disaipelna ta moglkrambuka.

“Ene mina yomba suwarata, yungu oltokuri ta kei ende mitna imbo enagledi piran, ye komnaiye amedi mogltre ana topo sramuna mere borambuka i kere kuno ere, ye moni sramuna pai tongwa i piran kuno eran ana ye yungu i kei kondinambuka.
Ipre ye yungu keinagledi mambuno ere keinambuka ba ye kei kondinambuka mere manan, ana yomba prapra i kandre kenaglmo sindre,
dinaglkwa, ‘Yagl i yungu mambuno bogl keingura, ba kei kondinambuka mere manga.’

“Mo king ta ende menda pi king ta kunda bogl tenagledi eran, ye komnaiye kana amedi mogl ana ye pir wakai eran yombuglomo kuno eran, ye kimbirmonem 10,000 bogl pi king ta kimbirmonem 20,000 bogl unan kunda bogl tenambuka.
Ye piran kunda bogl tenambuka kuno erekran, kakep yomba tau di endinan pi king ta konbauna bange wu panambara tengigl yendre dem munduwo bipokndi yenan kunda paikrambedi pre ka wakai ditenambuka.
Kuno yeglmere ene mina suwarata taragl kanekane ye kan ongwa i ta kinde kondokran, ye na disaipelna moglkrambuka.
Mundi druwomo paikrukwa
“Mundi taragl wakai, ba druwomo dundinan ana sraglmere ere druwomo aglke ikine endinambe?
Mundi i wakai ta yenan makan mina endinaglkwa mo bugla-kau de yenambara i suwarata endinaglkwa manga. I piyasi menda endingwa. “Yomba ta ka pirambuka pre kina panan kade, ka i pirondo!”

footnotes.text: Ka i Matyu 10:38 mina pangwa i kano.
